title: TV Antenna Installers - USA Wireless Announces Major Expansion into Over-the-Air Television Market | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
TV Antenna Installers - USA Wireless, a leading authorized provider of DIRECTV, proudly announces a new strategic expansion into the over-the-air (OTA) television market. Under the leadership of President Warren Schoen, the company is poised to revolutionize television access nationwide, allowing viewers to enjoy high-quality broadcast television programming alongside traditional streaming and cable services.
This ambitious initiative aims to accommodate the growing consumer demand for accessible television options. Many viewers are seeking alternatives that include an outdoor over-the-air antenna installation, a trend reminiscent of the television landscape of the 1970s and 80s. USA Wireless is dedicated to rebuilding the OTA footprint across the United States, ensuring viewers can enjoy high-quality broadcast television programming in addition to traditional cable services.
“Today’s consumers are looking for flexible, cost-effective solutions to enhance their viewing experience,” said Warren Schoen, President of USA Wireless. “Our expansion into the design and installation of outdoor over-the-air antenna systems reflects our commitment to providing innovative television solutions that cater to the evolving needs of viewing audiences. Given the addition of hundreds of new channels broadcasting over-the-air, our goal is to install high-quality outdoor antennas into television households across the country to achieve antenna household numbers as close to what they were in the 1970s and 1980s.”
With over 30 years of experience installing DIRECTV systems, USA Wireless leverages its expertise to deliver top-notch outdoor antennas with professional installation. Across the nation, their certified technicians custom design, build, install, and rigorously test every system they install. As the market for over-the-air antenna reception continues to grow, home owners, property and business managers and owners are increasingly seeking free OTA local TV service solutions for viewing audiences. USA Wireless stands ready to meet this demand. “I feel strongly that the need is now for television viewer-consumers must now have an OTA antenna service along with their streaming, cable, and satellite services,” says Warren Schoen, President of USA Wireless and their new AntennaTeam.com division.
